title: 第46章 一剑风华第47章 蔡云公子
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
赵宇先展豹步，向刚才那两人疾冲而去，他本来想用那套已使用纯熟的“十八破敌术”
，后一想还是用新的那套“风之剑”
法吧，用来对付那几个弱鸡，练练剑法不是很好吗？那两人看着就一小屁孩拿剑杀来，觉得很是可笑，仍一副骂定的、不可一世的逼样，看着提剑杀来的赵宇。
赵宇手中之剑一剑点出，就见几道剑光挥洒而去，那两个黑衣人眼中只见几道剑光闪过，还未回过神来，两颗脑袋滚落在地。
赵宇一剑掠过，根本不再去管这两个人。
又向最近的几人疾掠而去。
左一剑“风之飘飘”
，右一剑“雨之潇潇”
，又见两颗脑袋掉落。
然后左脚一点，右脚一窜，一步三腾龙腾身法展开，向靠左侧后边的两人飞掠而出，起手一招“疾风如电”
，又一招“倒卷西风”
，这两个黑衣人皆被腰宰。
又一步飘飞，来到右侧，手中剑光再度亮起，先一招“风云变幻”
，再一招“狂风骤起”
，一人从上至下一分为二，另一个自下斜上也差不多也一分为二。
至此，也就十多个呼吸，赵宇总共行进不到五十步，剑出不过十招，对方所谓的强者已被宰杀八人。
剩下的几个黑衣人这才缓过神来，想不到刚刚还活崩乱跳、凶神恶煞的八位同伴已然身死道消。
不是说一个连毛还长齐的小屁孩吗？只见其身法之高妙，剑法之神奇简直是无与伦比！
少年剑神！
剩下的几个黑衣人立马一声怪叫，狼奔豕突，各自逃窜，本来那个领头的瘦高个还想一搏，一看也是大惊失色，也立刻转身就逃。

赵宇本就最讨厌此人，一看其貌就知道此人阴险狡诈，心狠手辣，最可恨的是还喜欢装腔作势，令人作呕。
他本就立在几个黑衣人的中间，距离赵宇的停顿下来的地方不远，在他反应过来想转身逃跑之时，已为时已晚。
他虽在逃跑过程中还了二刀，但依旧难一死。
赵宇把最快一招“风驰电掣”
给了他，结局一个字，殁！
最后还抓了一个活的，因为那人是那吓得腿抽筋了，跑了几步自个倒下了。
至于如何审问那个黑衣人，就和赵宇没什么关系了，就由蔡家人去问吧。
起码有半到钟，蔡家人包括蔡忠等一干人等都处在呆痴之中，特别是那个娘娘腔蔡云的脸色更是一阵白，一阵红。
content_en:
Zhao Yu first showed off his leopard steps and rushed towards the two people just now. He originally wanted to use the "Eighteen Enemy Destroying Techniques" that he had already used proficiently.
, and then I thought about using the new set of "Wind Sword"
Law, isn't it good to use it to deal with those weak chickens and practice sword skills? The two of them thought it was ridiculous to see a little brat coming to kill with a sword, and they still looked at Zhao Yu who was coming to kill with a sword in a scolding and arrogant manner.
Zhao Yu pointed out the sword in his hand, and saw several sword lights swaying away. The two men in black only saw a few sword lights flashing in their eyes. Before they could recover, their two heads rolled to the ground.
Zhao Yu passed by with his sword and stopped caring about these two people.
Then he rushed towards the nearest few people.
Zuo Yijian "Feng Zhi Piao"
, a sword on the right "Rain's Xiaoxiao"
, and saw two more heads falling.
Then he moved his left foot slightly, then jumped with his right foot. He spread out his three-step dragon and soaring body technique, and flew out towards the two people behind him on the left. He started with a move of "Wind Like Lightning"
, another move to "reverse the west wind"
, these two men in black were both slaughtered.
Another step flew, and he came to the right. The sword light in his hand lit up again, and the first move was "Wind and Cloud Change"
, and another move "Sudden Wind Rises"
, one is divided into two from top to bottom, and the other is almost divided into two from bottom to top.
At this point, in just over ten breaths, Zhao Yu had marched less than fifty steps in total, could only make ten moves with his sword, and eight of the opponent's so-called strong men had been slaughtered.
Only then did the few remaining men in black regain their composure. Unexpectedly, the eight companions who had been jumping around with ferocious looks just now were already dead.
Aren't you talking about a little brat with all his hair? I can only see that his body skills are superb, and his sword skills are simply unparalleled!
Young Sword God!
The remaining men in black immediately let out strange screams, ran like wolves, and fled each other. The tall and thin man in the lead originally wanted to fight, but when he saw it, he was shocked and turned around to run away.
Zhao Yu hated this person the most. One look at his appearance and he knew that he was cunning, cunning and cruel. The most hateful thing was that he liked to put on airs, which was disgusting.
He was already standing in the middle of several men in black, not far from where Zhao Yu stopped. By the time he reacted and wanted to turn around and run away, it was already too late.
Although he returned the knife twice during his escape, he still had a hard time dying.
Zhao Yu used his fastest move, "Wind and Lightning"
I gave him the ending with one word, death!
Finally, we caught one alive, because the man was so frightened that his legs cramped, and he fell down after running a few steps.
As for how to interrogate the man in black, it has nothing to do with Zhao Yu. Let the Cai family ask.
For at least half an hour, everyone in the Cai family, including Cai Zhong, was in a daze. Especially the sissy Cai Yun's face turned pale and red.
